summary: Tail mechanism real but small; numbers copied from the wrong profile; the spec's own condition is an okc check first and only scored submits remain today; a master-based gain (<= ~2% on verify_32, ~+0.3% headline) cannot pass the 1.4021x occ2 board entry. Hold until checks reset, like wg-producer-direct-x-rows-no-gather.
justification: wg_kernel walks total = nc x n_tiles items over G=132 CTAs; makespan ceil(total/G). Real per-kernel times on master: wg_kernel<true> ~238 us, <false> ~112-119 us (~15 us per item), not 303/148. The S=2 rule only helps when r = total mod G <= G/2 (64*nc mod 132 for w13, 32*nc mod 132 for w2): a coin flip per kernel, expected 0-15 us of 358-405 us. True stream-k or S = min(KS, floor(G/r)) recovers the tail for every r with the same ticket/workspace machinery. Prior 'none' is defensible (wg-pdl-gather-w13-w2-chain targets the same tail from the dependent side, flat).
confounders: wg-pdl-gather-w13-w2-chain (landed): PDL hides ~2-6 us of the same tail; savings overlap.
align-two-phase-port-from17 / combo F2 align2 front end: set nc and so r; log q, r, S per kernel.
combo-wg-occ2-v64-hot-interleave-align2 (board best, not on master): G=264, NMAX 64; a master result does not carry over.
interference: No companion: self-attributing via printed q, r, S and the prepare-time per-kernel A/B; the real question (which r the judge routing gives) is a print.
